name: todo
description: Todo lists, personal or shared within a group: items with a due date and someone to do them, shown on Home when they fall due

nodeTypes.label: Todo list
nodeTypes.description: A list of things to do, holding its items: in its owner's home under todos/, or in a group's shared home under todos/, where every member of the group shares it.

nodeTypes.label: Todo item
nodeTypes.description: One thing to do, in a todo list: its title, whether it is done and by whom and when, and optionally the day it is due and who is to do it.
